## Problem Statement

Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe clearly.
(e.g. "I'm always frustrated when I have to manually [...]")

## Proposed Solution

What would you like to see added or changed? Be as specific as possible.

## Alternative Solutions

Have you considered any alternative approaches or workarounds?

## Relevant Tool(s)

Which tool(s) does this affect? (e.g. SVM XOR, Coding Compare, Hex to Binary, PR Codes Lookup, Backup Converter, API, or "New Tool")

## Additional Context

Add any mockups, references, or examples that support your request.
